subject: Serena Williams Says Daughter Olympia Pushed Her Back Into Tennis

Serena and Venus Williams have received a wildcard for the 2026 Wimbledon doubles. Serena, who 'evolved' from tennis in 2022, is using this as a sentimental return to the sport.

This is a WHY error. The claim attributes the 'why' to a child's wisdom, while the reality is a strategic 'why' of brand maintenance.
